summary: Fix correctly prevents the handler variable from being overwritten when MiddlewareNotUsed is raised, using a temporary adapted_handler and committing it only via the try/else clause on success. This is a minimal, targeted fix matching the root cause described in the issue.

issues.description: Relies on try/except/else control flow which is correct but slightly less obvious at a glance than an explicit conditional; a brief comment could clarify why the assignment is deferred to the else branch.
